wholePhysicalScope: The named OpenStreetMap station outline establishes the full span, depth and forward central section. Cherry Street fixes the principal front.
lodDetails: Four detail levels retain the headhouse, central portico and low side wings. Near views resolve the glazing, stone surrounds and lettering.
limitations: Heights, opening counts at the remote ends and detail on the track side are architectural estimates. The parcel-mapped building outline supplies the plan.
The main elevation is represented in restored historic form. The relief carvings, window joinery and roof fittings are simplified.
The model ends at the surviving headhouse and attached ranges. Platforms, transit staging and adjoining rail structures are outside its scope.
